title: Reflect media slot
description: An empty stand-in for a video, illustration or screenshot in the frame the original gives it: a soft radial wash of the theme's glow colour (centred, rising from the bottom, or falling from the top) or a flat muted panel. It can fade in as it enters the window. Shows its child instead when one is given.
notes: size, aspect ratio and radius come from className; children are cropped like object-fit: cover
reveal uses a CSS view timeline; browsers without one show it at once
